description: Capabilities for the recorder window (Record mode).
_comment: No shell permission on purpose. FFmpeg is spawned from Rust only, where the
argument list is built by us and the webview cannot influence it. Granting
shell:allow-execute here would let anything running in the webview start
arbitrary processes on a machine that handles participant video.
No fs permission either: that grant belongs to the station window's
capability alone (capabilities/station.json) — the recorder webview never
asked for filesystem access and must not inherit it in the merge.
